progression.narrative: The performance opens on B2 and dwells most on C in Farang Ba Shushtari Gardan. The line peaks at F4 (328.4 Hz) at 0:13.6. It closes on Eb4, not the tonic (Ak3 → C4 → G3 → F4 → D3 → Eb4).
